name: geometer-pathway-orders
description: Pre-orders with an advance payment for tiffin services, bakeries and caterers: a pickup or delivery slot, stock and per-day limits, cut-off times, 'confirmed' judged from the payment record (or the owner's UPI mark), refunds that ask the owner. Runs as a server (one SQLite file per shop, a signed-webhook inbox, an approvals relay for refunds Guard holds, a go-live certificate and a monthly report), checked against stand-in services. No dependencies.
